items.desc_now: Expose any local service on a random cloudflared domain with one password — QR code for LAN, QR + password for public, per-node routing managed in the DSH settings panel.

Keeps bulk output out of the conversation from both ends: a routing gate refuses flooding calls (curl/wget in any shell, web_fetch/read_page), and output already inside is slimmed after the tool runs — JSON re-encoded losslessly, tables windowed with line numbers, logs folded keeping diagnostics — originals readable byte-for-byte via ctk_retrieve.
items.desc_prev: DeepSeek Harness bundle: native ctk_* sandbox tools, a local FTS5 knowledge base, and a routing gate that keeps bulk output out of the conversation. No third-party runtime dependencies.
